description: This file defines a pipeline behavior for validation within a MediatR request processing pipeline in an ASP.NET Core application. It applies FluentValidation validators to incoming requests and throws an exception if validation fails.

classes.name: ValidationPipelineBehavior
classes.description: A pipeline behavior class that validates requests using registered FluentValidation validators before passing the request to the next handler.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes validation on the request. Throws ValidationException if validation fails, otherwise proceeds to the next handler.
